blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Without using the tables, find the value of: \(\cos(-1230^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angle hamari table wale chhote angles (\(30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}\)) mein se nahi hai, kyunke yeh bohat bara aur negative bhi hai.
Diya kya hai? Sirf ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Us ki exact value, table ke baghair.
Rule kaunsa? Teen kaam: minus sign ka faisla (even/odd rule), poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hatana, aur phir allied angle ke saath quadrant ka sign (ASTC rule).
Plan: cos even hai is liye minus hat jayega, phir chakkar hata kar \(180^{\circ} - \theta\) wala allied angle.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos(-1230^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: (1) even/odd rule se minus sign ka faisla, (2) \(360^{\circ}\) ke poore chakkar hatana, (3) jo angle bache usay allied angle ki shakal mein likh kar quadrant se sign tay karna. Yeh tareeqa is liye kaam karta hai ke har ratio \(360^{\circ}\) ke baad dobara wohi value deta hai, aur allied angles ka rule bara angle chhote angle mein badal deta hai.

Minus sign hatayein
\[\cos(-1230^{\circ}) = \cos 1230^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\), yani cosine even function hai. Angle ko clockwise ghumayein ya anticlockwise, point ka x-coordinate wohi rehta hai, is liye cos par minus ka koi asar nahi hota.

Poore chakkar hatayein
\[1230^{\circ} = 3(360^{\circ}) + 150^{\circ}\]
\[\cos 1230^{\circ} = \cos 150^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(360^{\circ}\) ek poora chakkar hai. Teen chakkar \(1080^{\circ}\) bante hain aur \(1230 - 1080 = 150\) bachta hai. Teen chakkar ghoom kar arm wapas usi jagah aa jata hai, is liye ratio bhi wohi rehta hai. Yeh aise hi hai jaise ghari ki sui 12 ghante baad wapas usi number par hoti hai.

Allied angle istemal karein
\[\cos 150^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= -\cos 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) \(90^{\circ}\) ka even multiple (2 guna) hai, is liye cos cos hi rehta hai. Sign ke liye dekhein ke \(150^{\circ}\) kis quadrant mein hai: \(90^{\circ}\) aur \(180^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan, yani quadrant II, jahan sirf sin positive hota hai. Is liye cos negative.
Dhyan dein: sign hamesha asal angle (\(150^{\circ}\)) ke quadrant se lete hain, chhote angle \(30^{\circ}\) se nahi.

Exact value rakhein
\[-\cos 30^{\circ} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: Special angles ki table se \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\). Minus sign pichhle qadam se saath aaya.

Tasdeeq: doosre raste se
\[\cos 150^{\circ} = \cos(90^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= -\sin 60^{\circ} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(90^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai, is liye cos badal kar sin (co-ratio) ban gaya; quadrant II ki wajah se sign phir bhi minus. Dono raste ek hi jawab dete hain, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) likha hai, jo ghalat hai. \(\cos(-1230^{\circ}) = \cos 150^{\circ}\) hai aur \(150^{\circ}\) quadrant II mein hai jahan cos negative hota hai. Sahi jawab \(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) hai. Sabaq: answer key par andha bharosa na karein; quadrant aur sign khud check karein.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Without using the tables, find the value of: \(\tan(-1035^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angle hamari table wale chhote angles (\(30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}\)) mein se nahi hai, kyunke yeh bohat bara aur negative bhi hai.
Diya kya hai? Sirf ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Us ki exact value, table ke baghair.
Rule kaunsa? Teen kaam: minus sign ka faisla (even/odd rule), poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hatana, aur phir allied angle ke saath quadrant ka sign (ASTC rule).
Plan: tan odd hai is liye minus bahar aayega, phir chakkar hata kar \(360^{\circ} - \theta\) wala allied angle, aur aakhir mein dono minus signs ko milana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\tan(-1035^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: (1) even/odd rule se minus sign ka faisla, (2) \(360^{\circ}\) ke poore chakkar hatana, (3) jo angle bache usay allied angle ki shakal mein likh kar quadrant se sign tay karna. Yeh tareeqa is liye kaam karta hai ke har ratio \(360^{\circ}\) ke baad dobara wohi value deta hai, aur allied angles ka rule bara angle chhote angle mein badal deta hai.

Minus sign bahar nikalein
\[\tan(-1035^{\circ}) = -\tan 1035^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\), yani tangent odd function hai. Angle ulti taraf ghumane se y-coordinate ka sign badal jata hai magar x ka nahi, is liye \(\frac{y}{x}\) ka sign ulta ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh minus sign yaad rakhna hai, aakhir mein wapas lagana hai.

Poore chakkar hatayein
\[1035^{\circ} = 2(360^{\circ}) + 315^{\circ}\]
\[\tan 1035^{\circ} = \tan 315^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Do chakkar \(720^{\circ}\) hain aur \(1035 - 720 = 315\) bachta hai. Teesra chakkar \(1080^{\circ}\) ho jata, jo \(1035^{\circ}\) se bara hai, is liye sirf do chakkar hatte hain.

Allied angle istemal karein
\[\tan 315^{\circ} = \tan(360^{\circ} - 45^{\circ})\]
\[= -\tan 45^{\circ} = -1\]
Kyun: \(360^{\circ}\) even multiple hai (\(4 \times 90^{\circ}\)), is liye tan tan hi rehta hai. \(315^{\circ}\) quadrant IV mein hai (\(270^{\circ}\) aur \(360^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan), jahan sirf cos positive hai; tan negative. \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) table se.

Pehla minus sign wapas lagayein
\[\tan(-1035^{\circ}) = -(-1)\]
\[= 1\]
Kyun: Step 2 wala minus aur quadrant IV wala minus aapas mein multiply hote hain: minus into minus plus. Yahi woh jagah hai jahan aksar students ek minus bhool jate hain.

Tasdeeq: negative angle mein seedha chakkar jor dein
\[-1035^{\circ} + 3(360^{\circ}) = 45^{\circ}\]
\[\tan 45^{\circ} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Poore chakkar jorne se bhi koi ratio nahi badalta. \(-1035 + 1080 = 45\), aur \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Dono tareeqon ka jawab ek hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(-1\) likha hai, jo ghalat hai. \(-1035^{\circ} + 1080^{\circ} = 45^{\circ}\), is liye \(\tan(-1035^{\circ}) = \tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Odd function wala minus aur quadrant IV wala minus aapas mein cancel ho jate hain. Sahi jawab \(1\) hai. Sabaq: answer key par andha bharosa na karein; quadrant aur sign khud check karein.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Without using the tables, find the value of: \(\sec(1140^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angle hamari table wale chhote angles (\(30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}\)) mein se nahi hai, kyunke yeh bohat bara hai.
Diya kya hai? Sirf ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Us ki exact value, table ke baghair.
Rule kaunsa? Teen kaam: minus sign ka faisla (even/odd rule), poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hatana, aur phir allied angle ke saath quadrant ka sign (ASTC rule).
Plan: angle positive hai, is liye sirf chakkar hatayenge, phir \(\sec\theta = 1/\cos\theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sec 1140^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: Angle positive hai, is liye minus sign ka koi masla nahi. Sirf \(360^{\circ}\) ke poore chakkar hatane hain, phir \(\sec\theta = \frac{1}{\cos\theta}\) lagana hai, kyunke hamari table mein cos hai, sec nahi.

Poore chakkar hatayein
\[1140^{\circ} = 3(360^{\circ}) + 60^{\circ}\]
\[\sec 1140^{\circ} = \sec 60^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Teen chakkar \(1080^{\circ}\), aur \(1140 - 1080 = 60\). Har ratio \(360^{\circ}\) ke baad wohi value dohrata hai, is liye teen chakkar hatane se kuch nahi badla. Ab angle seedha table wala \(60^{\circ}\) hai, allied angle ki zaroorat hi nahi.

Secant ko cosine mein badlein
\[\sec 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\cos 60^{\circ}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{1/2} = 2\]
Kyun: Secant, cosine ka ulta (reciprocal) hai. \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\), aur \(\frac{1}{2}\) ka ulta 2 hai. \(60^{\circ}\) quadrant I mein hai jahan sab ratios positive hain, is liye jawab positive.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 1140^{\circ} = \cos 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[2 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi angle ke liye \(\sec\theta \times \cos\theta = 1\) hota hai. Hamara jawab yeh shart poori karta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Without using the tables, find the value of: \(\operatorname{cosec}(-690^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angle hamari table wale chhote angles (\(30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}\)) mein se nahi hai, kyunke yeh bohat bara aur negative bhi hai.
Diya kya hai? Sirf ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Us ki exact value, table ke baghair.
Rule kaunsa? Teen kaam: minus sign ka faisla (even/odd rule), poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hatana, aur phir allied angle ke saath quadrant ka sign (ASTC rule).
Plan: cosec odd hai is liye minus bahar, ek chakkar hatana, phir \(360^{\circ} - \theta\), aur dono minus signs milana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\operatorname{cosec}(-690^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: (1) even/odd rule se minus sign ka faisla, (2) \(360^{\circ}\) ke poore chakkar hatana, (3) jo angle bache usay allied angle ki shakal mein likh kar quadrant se sign tay karna. Yeh tareeqa is liye kaam karta hai ke har ratio \(360^{\circ}\) ke baad dobara wohi value deta hai, aur allied angles ka rule bara angle chhote angle mein badal deta hai.

Minus sign bahar nikalein
\[\operatorname{cosec}(-690^{\circ}) = -\operatorname{cosec} 690^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta}\), aur sin odd hai: \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\). Jab sin ka sign badalta hai to us ke ulte (cosec) ka sign bhi badal jata hai. Is liye cosec bhi odd hai.

Ek poora chakkar hatayein
\[690^{\circ} = 360^{\circ} + 330^{\circ}\]
\[\operatorname{cosec} 690^{\circ} = \operatorname{cosec} 330^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(690 - 360 = 330\). Doosra chakkar \(720^{\circ}\) hota, jo \(690^{\circ}\) se bara hai, is liye sirf ek chakkar hatta hai.

Allied angle istemal karein
\[\operatorname{cosec} 330^{\circ} = \operatorname{cosec}(360^{\circ} - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= -\operatorname{cosec} 30^{\circ} = -2\]
Kyun: \(360^{\circ}\) even multiple hai, is liye cosec cosec hi rehta hai. \(330^{\circ}\) quadrant IV mein hai jahan sin negative hai, aur cosec bhi sin ke saath negative hota hai. \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\), is liye \(\operatorname{cosec} 30^{\circ} = 2\).

Pehla minus sign wapas lagayein
\[\operatorname{cosec}(-690^{\circ}) = -(-2)\]
\[= 2\]
Kyun: Odd function wala minus aur quadrant IV wala minus milkar plus ban gaye.
Dhyan dein: aksar students sirf ek minus lagate hain aur jawab \(-2\) likh dete hain; dono minus signs ginna zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq: negative angle mein seedha chakkar jor dein
\[-690^{\circ} + 2(360^{\circ}) = 30^{\circ}\]
\[\operatorname{cosec} 30^{\circ} = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(-690 + 720 = 30\). Chakkar jorne se ratio nahi badalta, aur \(\operatorname{cosec} 30^{\circ} = 2\). Jawab pakka.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(-2\) likha hai, jo ghalat hai. \(-690^{\circ} + 720^{\circ} = 30^{\circ}\), is liye \(\operatorname{cosec}(-690^{\circ}) = \operatorname{cosec} 30^{\circ} = 2\). Sahi jawab \(2\) hai. Sabaq: answer key par andha bharosa na karein; quadrant aur sign khud check karein.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Without using the tables, find the value of: \(\cot(1320^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angle hamari table wale chhote angles (\(30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}\)) mein se nahi hai, kyunke yeh bohat bara hai.
Diya kya hai? Sirf ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Us ki exact value, table ke baghair.
Rule kaunsa? Teen kaam: minus sign ka faisla (even/odd rule), poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hatana, aur phir allied angle ke saath quadrant ka sign (ASTC rule).
Plan: chakkar hata kar \(180^{\circ} + \theta\) wala allied angle, aur quadrant III ka sign.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cot 1320^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: Angle positive hai, is liye pehle \(360^{\circ}\) ke chakkar hatayenge, phir bache hue angle ko \(180^{\circ} + \theta\) ki shakal mein likh kar quadrant se sign tay karenge.

Poore chakkar hatayein
\[1320^{\circ} = 3(360^{\circ}) + 240^{\circ}\]
\[\cot 1320^{\circ} = \cot 240^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Teen chakkar \(1080^{\circ}\), aur \(1320 - 1080 = 240\). Chaar chakkar \(1440^{\circ}\) ho jate, jo zyada hai.

Allied angle istemal karein
\[\cot 240^{\circ} = \cot(180^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= \cot 60^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) even multiple hai, is liye cot cot hi rehta hai. \(240^{\circ}\) quadrant III mein hai (\(180^{\circ}\) se \(270^{\circ}\)), jahan tan aur us ka ulta cot dono positive hain. Is liye koi minus nahi lagta.

Exact value rakhein
\[\cot 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\tan 60^{\circ}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\), aur cot us ka ulta hai. Chahein to \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\) bhi likh sakte hain; dono barabar hain.

Tasdeeq: doosre raste se
\[\cot 240^{\circ} = \cot(270^{\circ} - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= \tan 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(270^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai, is liye cot badal kar tan (co-ratio) ban gaya; quadrant III mein tan positive hai. Dono raston se ek hi jawab.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Without using the tables, find the value of: \(\cos(-240^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angle hamari table wale chhote angles (\(30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}\)) mein se nahi hai, kyunke yeh bohat bara balke negative hai.
Diya kya hai? Sirf ek ratio aur ek angle. Find kya karna hai? Us ki exact value, table ke baghair.
Rule kaunsa? Teen kaam: minus sign ka faisla (even/odd rule), poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) hatana, aur phir allied angle ke saath quadrant ka sign (ASTC rule).
Plan: cos even hai is liye minus hat jayega; \(240^{\circ}\) ek chakkar se kam hai, is liye seedha \(180^{\circ} + \theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos(-240^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: Even rule se minus hatayenge. \(240^{\circ}\) ek chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) se chhota hai, is liye chakkar hatane ka qadam nahi. Phir \(180^{\circ} + \theta\) wala allied angle aur quadrant ka sign.

Minus sign hatayein
\[\cos(-240^{\circ}) = \cos 240^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Cosine even hai, \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\). Minus sign ka cos par koi asar nahi.

Allied angle istemal karein
\[\cos 240^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= -\cos 60^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) even multiple, is liye cos cos hi raha. \(240^{\circ}\) quadrant III mein hai jahan sirf tan (aur cot) positive hain; cos negative hai.

Exact value rakhein
\[-\cos 60^{\circ} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Table se \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\); minus quadrant III se aaya.

Tasdeeq: ek chakkar jor kar
\[-240^{\circ} + 360^{\circ} = 120^{\circ}\]
\[\cos 120^{\circ} = -\cos 60^{\circ} = -\dfrac{1}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(-240^{\circ}\) ko ek chakkar jorne se \(120^{\circ}\) mila, jo quadrant II mein hai aur wahan bhi cos negative hai. Dono tareeqe ek jawab dete hain.
Dhyan dein: \(-240^{\circ}\) ko quadrant III ka angle samajhna ghalat hai; minus angle clockwise ghoomta hai aur yeh asal mein quadrant II mein khatam hota hai. Isi liye pehle minus hatana aasaan rasta hai.
